session_validation.identity_unavailable: 503 identity_unavailable; preserve cookies; never admit upstream requests

status.scope: local Gateway readiness; no downstream status requests

start_oidc_login.browser_binding: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax host-only SHA256(state) cookie; newest attempt replaces prior attempt

workspace_bootstrap.agent_activation_state: enabled or disabled, present exactly when lifecycle_state is created
workspace_bootstrap.state_source: Controller management projection in the existing paginated list; no ACP or Runtime lookup

workspace_state.scope: original authenticated organization and principal only; no query fields
workspace_state.denied: 200 sanitized offline state; no session or configuration revision disclosure

workspace_state_watch.replay: none; reject query fields and Last-Event-ID
workspace_state_watch.disconnect: cancel upstream observation only; never cancel or replay ACP work
workspace_state_watch.source_failure: 503 before first snapshot; after streaming close without inventing state

workspace_acp_http.authentication: browser_session; direct ACP routing without Controller lookup; ACP owns Agent/Session authorization
workspace_acp_http.csrf: POST and DELETE require X-Antnest-CSRF-Token matching the cookie
workspace_acp_http.origin: when supplied must match Gateway; not required for non-browser HTTP clients
workspace_acp_http.message_payload: opaque; no ACP translation or login credential forwarding
workspace_acp_http.streaming: unbuffered SSE; client disconnect cancels upstream receive request only
workspace_acp_http.connection_authority: ACP Service; connection ID is not an authentication credential
workspace_acp_http.already_forwarded_work: same policy as WebSocket; no idle authorization polling

workspace_acp.authentication: browser_session; direct ACP routing without Controller lookup; ACP owns Agent/Session authorization
workspace_acp.message_admission: resolve original cookie token before forwarding each complete client message; require active original User/Organization/Membership
workspace_acp.message_payload: opaque; no ACP translation or login credential forwarding
workspace_acp.already_forwarded_work: ACP owns authorization, Run, cancellation and disconnect semantics
workspace_acp.idle_connection: no Gateway background polling; ACP owns local access updates and output subscriptions

workspace_bridge_api.trust: strip all incoming X-Antnest identity fields before injecting verified values
workspace_bridge_api.body_limit: at least existing negotiated ACP multimodal input limit

workspace_bridge_events.upstream_disconnect: observation only; never cancel ACP Run

workspace_application.return_to: validated same-origin /workspace/ path preserving agent and session query

organization_display.transport: X-Antnest-Organization-Slug and X-Antnest-Organization-Name; one canonical unpadded Base64URL value per header, encoding the exact UTF-8 string
organization_display.scope: authenticated Agent UI Workspace API and SSR HTML only; anonymous assets and other upstreams receive neither header
organization_display.validation: required non-whitespace strings; Node rejects missing, duplicate, non-canonical Base64URL or invalid UTF-8 values with 401 before discovery
organization_display.authorization: display only; organization_id, user_id, membership_id, roles and active state retain authorization authority
organization_display.freshness: no metadata cache; each authenticated request resolves Identity again; re-bootstrap and SSR reload observe the current name without changing session scope
organization_display.deployment: Gateway producer #92 first; Agent UI bootstrap consumer #93 then activates the verifiedWorkspacePrincipal schema; full integration follows both local admissions
